description: Fetch recent posts by one person or company, or with `query` every public post with those words: text, images, video, document or article, and published_at. A person's posts also carry reaction_count (with the breakdown by kind), comment_count and repost_count; a company's carry the text and the date, with the counts null, at a much lower price. For the counts on one of them, call linkedin/post. Give exactly one of `url` or `company_url` or `query`. Costs 7 credits (3 with `company_url`), cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

company_url.description: A company page URL. Up to 7 pages of 10.

cursor.description: The `meta.next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

limit.description: At most this many results, 1–100. A page can hold fewer while `next_cursor` is set: read until it is null.

posted_within.description: Only posts from the last day, week or month.

query.description: Words in the post: every public post that has them, newest first.

url.description: A person's public profile URL. Their latest posts, on one page.

name: get_linkedin_posts
title: Get or search LinkedIn posts
